QUOTE: The reason string always says why the whole-repo tier was chosen: either "no `index_scope:` is declared" or the specific rejection message.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the fallback carries a reason string explaining which scope was chosen and why (undeclared vs. rejected), and the decision tree shows `_Rejected(reason)` and a `DerivedScope` source label, so the scope is never silently guessed.
